limitations: Body-derived shells retain anatomy and source-body UVs; no sewn pattern, cloth weave or textile-scale claim
Open neck/cuffs/armholes/hem/waist/ankles are not hemmed and trim boundaries may show angular cuts
Waistcoat front/armhole clipping and lower-torso trouser front envelope may fold or self-intersect; no collision accepted
No historical front-fall closure has been constructed; closures/buttons/hat/hunting coat omitted
No textures, skin/hair, canonical master, fourLODs, GLB, animation, image or scene placement
All colour, material pairing, cut, ease and footwear are conjectural; no photographic or named clothing claim
